origin: base centre on the terrain line (y=0) for every model; fire models at their ember-bed centre; firewood at stack centre
physical_dimensions_note: No inspected source measures a Breznice hearth/oven superstructure. The only E bound used is the excavated area 0.2-1.31 m2 of the 11 'O-pec' features (Z22 via settlement-features.md); the base patch (~1.19 x 1.19 m, ~1.1 m2) is a design value inside that range, not a measured object.

models.role: burnt-earth patch: shallow hollow (floor y=0.010) with a fire-reddened raised rim (crest ~0.064), closed solid with a hidden skirt to y=-0.03; the attested part of the feature. Carries all five hearth anchors.

states.description: Mutually exclusive in production: one base + exactly one top (open OR dome) + optional one fire (none = cold, embers, lit) + optional firewood. Tops and fires are placed only through hearth_base anchors.
states.repeated_instance_demo: previews/godot_repeat_demo_ortho25_grid.png: 6 hearth sets (mixed states, 4 with POT/firewood) + 2 HOUSE + 1 PERSON; scene totals in checks/godot_shot_log.json (scene_mesh_stats)

kit_unique_textures.name: kiln_atlas
kit_unique_textures.note: same embedded atlas in every GLB; procedural (numpy) original work, source/textures/kiln_atlas.png

emissive_note: KILN_glow uses core emissiveTexture + emissiveFactor [1,1,1] (no KHR_materials_emissive_strength); Godot imports it as emission_enabled with energy 1.0.
parts_and_uncertainties: E (K22/Z22 via settlement-features.md): 11 Breznice features coded 'O-pec' = burnt surface or fill, excavated 0.2-1.31 m2, preserved depth 5-25 cm; classification partly disputed by a second analyst. Only the base patch footprint is bounded by this.
R: hollow depth (~0.054 m below the rim crest), rim height and the fire-reddened/ash colour zones of the base.

R: whether anything stood above the burnt patch. The open stone/clay ring and the low clay dome are two equally provisional alternatives; neither is verified for Breznice. The dome is NOT a pottery kiln claim and has no chimney or brick look.
R: dome size (0.97 x 0.91 x 0.61 m, width x depth x height above y0), wall thickness ~0.10 m, mouth shape/size and its +Z orientation; offset of the dome 0.10 m behind base_center.
R: fire geometry, log count/arrangement, flame form and colour; fuel species not represented (S22 charcoal list: oak dominant).
R: pot_rest beside (not on) the fire; no cooking method is implied.
R/F: firewood stack form, log length and placement (WOOD-001 notes: stack form/size/placement R).
Not modelled: clay weights as spit supports (C19 does not confirm such use) and the MC13 crescent fire-dog (regional, ritual-ambiguous comparator; HEARTH-001 held).
Optional person_tending.glb motion study was not produced (see CHANGELOG); only static PERSON r001 fixture placement on tend_origin is shown.

deviations: D1 tend_origin moved from the draft (0,0,-0.8) to (-0.30,0,0.78) facing fire_center (yaw 158.96 deg): with +Z front the dome mouth faces +Z, so a tender behind the oven could not reach it; front-left placement keeps the mouth visible from the (18,18,18) village camera.
D2 added anchor firewood_spot and model firewood_stack.glb (WOOD-001 optional dressing requested by the assignment).
D3 dome centre offset 0.10 m to -Z relative to base_center (fire stays at the shared fire_center) so lit/embers states show through the mouth at village scale; anchors stay identical for both tops.
D4 optional person_tending.glb motion study not delivered.
D5 base includes a 0.03 m skirt below y=0 (bounds min y=-0.03) to hide terrain unevenness; visible top surface is above y=0.
